assumptions: MongoDB is configured as replica set for transactions
PhonePe webhook credentials are properly configured
Environment variables are secure and not exposed
Production traffic expected: 30k visitors from Instagram

criticalIssues.title: Race Condition in Stock Reservation
criticalIssues.description: Multiple concurrent requests can oversell stock due to non-atomic check-then-update pattern
reproductionSteps: 1. Set product stock to 1
2. Send 5 concurrent requests to reserve 1 unit each
3. All 5 requests pass stock check
4. All 5 requests successfully reserve stock
5. Result: 5 units reserved but only 1 available
criticalIssues.fix: Use atomic updateOne with $expr condition to check and update in single operation

criticalIssues.title: Missing Webhook Idempotency
criticalIssues.description: Webhook processing lacks proper idempotency checks, allowing duplicate order processing
reproductionSteps: 1. PhonePe sends webhook for successful payment
2. Webhook processed successfully, order confirmed
3. PhonePe retries webhook due to timeout
4. Second webhook processed, creates duplicate order
5. Customer charged twice for same purchase
criticalIssues.fix: Implement idempotency key checking using phonepeTransactionId before processing

criticalIssues.title: Insecure Console Logging
criticalIssues.description: Console logs expose presence of sensitive environment variables
reproductionSteps: 1. Check application logs
2. Observe JWT_SECRET, PHONEPE_MERCHANT_ID, PHONEPE_API_KEY status
3. Attacker can identify which secrets are configured
4. Reduces attack surface knowledge for malicious actors
criticalIssues.fix: Remove or replace with secure logging that doesn't expose configuration status

criticalIssues.title: Missing Reconciliation System
criticalIssues.description: Reconciliation service exists but may not be properly integrated with main webhook flow
reproductionSteps: 1. Webhook fails to process due to temporary DB issue
2. Payment succeeds at PhonePe but order not confirmed
3. Reconciliation runs 5 minutes later
4. Customer may have already contacted support
5. Revenue loss due to delayed order confirmation
criticalIssues.fix: Reduce reconciliation interval to 1-2 minutes and ensure proper integration

criticalIssues.title: CORS Configuration Risk
criticalIssues.description: CORS allows both HTTP and HTTPS origins, creating security risk
reproductionSteps: 1. Attacker creates malicious site at http://shithaa.in
2. User visits malicious site
3. Malicious site makes API calls to backend
4. CORS allows the request
5. Potential for CSRF attacks
criticalIssues.fix: Remove HTTP origins from production CORS configuration
